finding: `tasks import --write --reconcile-mirror` can append a planning-mirror-reconcile transition to a done task without converging the planning mirror status, so the same task remains classified as `stale-import` immediately after the official recovery command succeeds.
expectedBehavior: A successful reconcile-mirror command should either update the authoritative planning mirror/frontmatter through the proper closeback surface, or fail closed with a recovery command that explains which repo/path must be mutated. It should not record a fresh reconcile transition while leaving the residue bucket unchanged.
evidenceOrRepro: On 2026-07-29, `node atm.mjs tasks import --from ...TASK-GIT-0025... --write --reconcile-mirror --json` and the equivalent TASK-GIT-0026 command both returned `ATM_TASKS_IMPORT_WRITE_READY` and wrote new `planning-mirror-reconcile` events. A subsequent `tasks audit --series GIT --summary` still reported TASK-GIT-0025 and TASK-GIT-0026 as `status: done`, `claimState: released`, `residueBucket: stale-import`, `nextActionCode: tasks-import` because the 3KLife planning frontmatter remained `planned`.
followUp: Unify planning-mirror reconcile with taskflow planning closeback. Add a regression where a done target-ledger task with planned external frontmatter runs reconcile-mirror; success must prove the residue bucket becomes no-residue, otherwise the command must not write a misleading reconcile event.
